recomputation_method: SHA-256 over the exact UTF-8 raw_response_text stored in the source artifact, without JSON reserialization.
reason: The initial digest was computed from an abbreviated OKX body that omitted the trailing sodUtc0 and sodUtc8 fields. The preserved raw_response_text contains both fields; hashing the complete stored response yields the corrected digest.
supersedes_only: The prior raw_response_sha256 value for the OKX source record.
does_not_change: Price, volume, spread or basis observations
